header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: said (اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ). The Prophet ﷺ replied to him, then he sat down in that gathering. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Twenty” (twenty rewards have been written for him). Then a third man came and said (اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكاَتُهُ), the Prophet ﷺ replied to his Salam, then he sat down in that gathering. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Thirty” (thirty rewards have been written for him)”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِنَّ اَوْلَي النَّاسِ بِاللهِ تَعَالَي مَنْ بَدَأَهُمْ بِالسَّلَامِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في فضل من بدا بالسلام رقم:٥١٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The one most deserving of nearness to Allah Ta'ala is the one who is first in saying “Salam”.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْبَادِيئُ بِالسَّلَامِ بَرِيْيءٌ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The one who is first in saying Salam has become free of pride.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ لِيْ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَا بُنَيَّ! اِذَا دَخَلْتَ عَلَي اَهْلِكَ فَسَلِّمْ يَكُوْنُ بَرَكَةً عَلَيْكَ وَعَلي اَهْلِ بَيْتِكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث حسن صحيح غريب باب ماجاء في التسليم ... رقم:٢٦٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “My dear son! When you enter your home, say Salam to the people of your home! This will be a cause of barakah for you and for the people of your home.”
